I added `PolicyControlFlowParser`, which takes the linear step graph from POL-2 and adds branch, retry and error-path structure to it. The `PolicyControlFlowParserTests` validation command passed (13 tests), and the full suite also passed (74 tests).

- **choose/when/otherwise:** each `choose` becomes one branch node. It gets one conditional edge per `when`, labelled with the exact condition text, plus an `otherwise` edge only when the policy has one.
- **Nesting:** steps inside a `when`, `otherwise` or `retry` become child nodes one level deeper than their parent, so a nested `choose` is not flattened.
- **retry:** the retry body ends with a `loop-back` edge back to its first step, labelled with the retry condition.
- **on-error:** the last step of each non-empty `inbound`, `backend` and `outbound` section gets an `error-path` edge to the first `on-error` step. The linear parser can't tell which step actually fails, so each section's last step stands in.
- **Empty clauses:** an empty `when` or `otherwise` gets an `(no policies)` placeholder node so its edge has a target.
